description: This file defines constants and utility functions for managing plugin paths within a build or plugin system, including constructing paths for plugins, test files, and distribution directories.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to a plugin's root directory based on plugin ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the path to a specific plugin file given plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the path to the distribution directory for a plugin.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Constructs the path to a distribution plugin file given plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Returns a string combining the plugin file path and a specific line number, representing a callsite reference.
